attemptHistory.cause: The isolated framework copy omitted the canonical libonnxruntime.dylib linker alias.
The source snapshot guard detected two documentation changes. The retry allowed exactly those non-build files and preserved the diff.
A component-based Path.starts_with check rejected the valid marked private root before updater I/O.
The accepted loopback socket inherited nonblocking mode and returned EAGAIN during the deliberate interrupted response.
PATH selected Android platform-tools sqlite3, which lacks FTS5, during profile seeding. The attempt was preserved and excluded from final profile evidence.
